Find a Burial

St Bartholomew's churchyard, Old Whittington · burial records 1679 to 2000

Where is the grave? A reference such as NBGS 7/12 means area, row and plot. "Map" opens the churchyard rows map at that plot. Positions come from the parish's area plans and are close but not exact, so look at the stones around the marker.

Before about 1880 the registers rarely say where a grave is. Those entries show the area if it was written down, or "Not recorded".

Dates before 1752 between 1 January and 24 March are given in the modern year; the old-style year is noted. Spellings are as written in the registers.

Burials after 2000 and home addresses are not shown here. For help with a burial, contact the Whittington History & Heritage Group.
